news.title: Editorial follow-up
news.summary: Authors of selected papers will be invited to submit extended versions for a special issue of Future Generation Computer Systems (Elsevier).

news.title: Best Paper Awards at every workshop
news.summary: Each NCA 2026 workshop assigns its own Best Paper Award, presented by the workshop organizers at the end of the workshop.
news.body:
Every NCA 2026 workshop has its own Best Paper Award. At the end of each workshop, the workshop organizers will present the award to the best paper of their workshop.

Workshops:
• NetAI 2026 – Tue 10 Nov, Sala B
• AiDDRESS-MED – Tue 10 Nov, Sala A
• ContinuumOps – Tue 10 Nov, Sala B
• DETECT – Tue 10 Nov, Sala A
• STiNCA – Thu 12 Nov, Sala A
• AI-SecureCom – Thu 12 Nov, Sala A
• ICON – Fri 13 Nov, Sala A
• GreenNet-AI 2026 – Fri 13 Nov, Sala A
